I replied in #strategic-pod thread to Nadia. I did not post a rate.

I couldn't find the Orlavine per-seat renewal rate in anything I can see, and the GBrain search returned nothing on it. Per-seat rates are finance figures, so they go only to June Osei-Lark, Anselm Grieve, and the account owner. Posting one in #strategic-pod would need June's or Anselm's approval. I did not file an approval request, since there's no figure yet to approve. Nadia can get the rate from June or Anselm and ask me again, and I'll route the approval then.
